layout.heroStructure: split asymmetric hero: left-aligned headline+CTA block, centered glowing geometric mark, right-aligned stacked micro-copy lines, all on a single full-bleed background row
layout.grid: loose 3-column implicit grid in the hero (text / icon / text) collapsing to single-column stack on mobile
layout.containerWidth: wide fluid container near full viewport width with generous side margins (~24-32px), no hard max-width card wrapper
layout.contentAlignment: left-aligned headline and body text, center-aligned hero mark, right-aligned supporting copy on desktop; fully center-aligned stack on mobile
layout.imagePlacement: single symbolic graphic centered in the hero vertical axis, floating above the fold with soft radial glow behind it
layout.header: slim single-row top nav, logo mark far left, text nav links center-left, pill-shaped CTA buttons far right

typography.fontPersonality: clean geometric sans-serif, neutral and engineering-flavored rather than warm
typography.headingScale: very large display heading (roughly 56-72px desktop) dropping to mid-large (~32-36px) on mobile
typography.weight: medium-to-regular nav and body text contrasted with a lighter-weight oversized display heading
typography.lineHeight: tight line-height on multi-line headline (close to 1.0-1.1x) with looser spacing on supporting list text
typography.letterSpacing: default to slightly tight tracking on headline, normal tracking on nav and body
typography.hierarchy: three clear tiers: small uppercase-free nav text, oversized headline as focal point, small secondary list copy as tertiary support

color.saturation: near-desaturated neutral grayscale palette with no chromatic accent color
color.temperature: neutral-cool, slightly warm-gray undertone in the background

photography.composition: single abstract 3D-rendered icon centered within a soft radial glow, isolated against flat background
photography.lighting: soft diffused top-down studio light with a bright halo glow radiating behind the object
photography.colorGrading: high-contrast monochrome rendering, pure black object against near-white glow
photography.cameraAngle: straight-on frontal view with no perspective tilt
photography.depthOfField: sharp focus throughout, glow providing the only depth cue
photography.environment: abstract void environment, no literal setting or background scene
photography.texture: smooth matte solid surface with subtle gradient shading for dimensionality
photography.imageRatio: roughly square bounding area for the central graphic, scaling down proportionally on mobile

components.buttons: fully rounded pill buttons, solid dark fill for primary action and white-outline ghost style for secondary action
components.cards: no visible card containers in this view; content sits directly on background
components.navigation: horizontal text-link nav with small dropdown carets, collapsing to a single hamburger icon on mobile
components.border: hairline 1px borders used sparingly on outlined buttons only
components.radius: large pill radius (999px) on buttons, no radius on text or logo elements
components.shadow: no hard drop shadows, only a diffuse glow effect behind the hero graphic

spacing.sectionGap: large vertical gap (~96-120px) between hero and logo strip
spacing.containerPadding: moderate horizontal padding (~24-32px) consistent across header and content
spacing.cardPadding: not applicable, no card components present
spacing.contentGap: medium gap (~16-24px) between headline, CTA row, and supporting text blocks
spacing.heroWhitespace: very generous negative space surrounding the central graphic and flanking text columns

motion.fade: likely gentle fade-in on hero text and graphic on initial load
motion.reveal: logo strip items may reveal with a subtle stagger on scroll into view
motion.scroll: minimal scroll-triggered movement, content largely static once loaded
motion.hover: subtle background/opacity shift on nav links and button hover states
motion.transition: short, fast easing (150-250ms) typical of UI micro-interactions rather than dramatic animation
